name: @lenticule-science/mandarin-language-algebra
description: mandarin-language-algebra: 普通话 (Standard Mandarin) as a language fiber — its lexicon, curated closed-class grammar, classifier morphotactics, reference and dictionary-based segmentation tables — presented as a live, discoverable, directly contractable micro-enterprise (a die) of linguistics-services-section. This is Mandarin's fiber over @lenticule-science/communicating's language-engine algebra, the same role lakota-language-algebra and tokipona-language-algebra play for their languages.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && tsc -p tsconfig.json
